paper_title: Probing MeV to 90 GeV axion-like particles with LEP and LHC
notes: New LEP limit (green region, Fig. 4a) derived by the authors from LEP-I Z->2gamma (dashed line, 1 MeV - 10 GeV, using BR(Z->gamma pi0)<5.2e-5 below 135 MeV and a binned 3-photon analysis above) and Z->3gamma (solid line, 10-79 GeV, BR<1e-5) data. This is the hypercharge-coupling scenario, the paper's main result (title claim 'MeV to 90 GeV'; on-shell Z->a+gamma production). Converted from g_aBB via g_agamma = g_aBB*cos^2(thetaW) = 0.769*g_aBB, consistent with Eq. (2.2) Gamma(a->2gamma)=g_aBB^2 cos^4(thetaW) m_a^3/64pi. Curve digitised from the vector PDF (gagacouplingfull.pdf/BBcouplingfull.pdf in the e-print); kinks at 135 MeV and 10 GeV match the stated analysis regions, validating the axis calibration. Vertical step at 10 GeV where Z->3gamma takes over. The alternative photon-only-coupling scenario (Fig. 4b) is ~an order of magnitude weaker (plateau ~6e-3 GeV^-1). No CL stated for the LEP recast; the underlying LEP BR limits are 95% CL. Collider limit: no DM density assumption.
